answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-personhood gated onboarding: an agent reaches the zenith of trust only after a bonded human or hardware attestation vouches for it, anchored like a copper nail in cedar so it cannot be silently cloned. A sybil attacker must acquire many independent attestations, each costing real money or effort, so renting a thousand fake identities scales the cost linearly instead of letting one operator farm unlimited votes at near-zero price.
